title: 制度 — system, institution
summary: A short passage about system, institution.
summary_en: A short passage about system, institution.

paragraphs.text: 这所大学在高等教育改革中试行了更加灵活的课程制度。
paragraphs.hanzi: 这所大学在高等教育改革中试行了更加灵活的课程制度。
paragraphs.pinyin: zhè suǒ dà xué zài gāo děng jiào yù gǎi gé zhōng shì xíng le gèng jiā líng huó de kè chéng zhì dù 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄓㄜˋ ㄙㄨㄛˇ ㄉㄚˋ ㄒㄩㄝˊ ㄗㄞˋ ㄍㄠ ㄉㄥˇ ㄐㄧㄠˋ ㄩˋ ㄍㄞˇ ㄍㄜˊ ㄓㄨㄥ ㄕˋ ㄒㄧㄥˊ ㄌㄜ˙ ㄍㄥˋ ㄐㄧㄚ ㄌㄧㄥˊ ㄏㄨㄛˊ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄎㄜˋ ㄔㄥˊ ㄓˋ ㄉㄨˋ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Zhè suǒ dàxué zài gāoděng jiàoyù gǎigé zhōng shìxíng le gèngjiā línghuó de kèchéng zhìdù.
paragraphs.translation: This university has trialled a more flexible curriculum system in higher education reform.
paragraphs.translation_en: This university has trialled a more flexible curriculum system in higher education reform.
paragraphs.translation_id: Universitas ini telah menguji coba sistem kurikulum yang lebih fleksibel dalam reformasi pendidikan tinggi.

paragraphs.text: 这些文书的出土，为研究地方制度提供了第一手材料。
paragraphs.hanzi: 这些文书的出土，为研究地方制度提供了第一手材料。
paragraphs.pinyin: zhè xiē wén shū de chū tǔ ， wèi yán jiū dì fāng zhì dù tí gōng le dì yī shǒu cái liào 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄓㄜˋ ㄒㄧㄝ ㄨㄣˊ ㄕㄨ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄔㄨ ㄊㄨˇ ， ㄨㄟˋ ㄧㄢˊ ㄐㄧㄡ ㄉㄧˋ ㄈㄤ ㄓˋ ㄉㄨˋ ㄊㄧˊ ㄍㄨㄥ ㄌㄜ˙ ㄉㄧˋ ㄧ ㄕㄡˇ ㄘㄞˊ ㄌㄧㄠˋ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Zhèxiē wénshū de chūtǔ, wèi yánjiū dìfāng zhìdù tígōng le dì-yī-shǒu cáiliào.
paragraphs.translation: The discovery of these documents provides first-hand material for the study of local institutions.
paragraphs.translation_en: The discovery of these documents provides first-hand material for the study of local institutions.
paragraphs.translation_id: Penemuan dokumen-dokumen ini menyediakan bahan primer untuk studi mengenai lembaga-lembaga lokal.

paragraphs.text: 学校正在制订新的安全制度。
paragraphs.hanzi: 学校正在制订新的安全制度。
paragraphs.pinyin: xué xiào zhèng zài zhì dìng xīn de ān quán zhì dù 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄒㄩㄝˊ ㄒㄧㄠˋ ㄓㄥˋ ㄗㄞˋ ㄓˋ ㄉㄧㄥˋ ㄒㄧㄣ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄢ ㄑㄩㄢˊ ㄓˋ ㄉㄨˋ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Xuéxiào zhèngzài zhìdìng xīn de ānquán zhìdù.
paragraphs.translation: The school is formulating a new safety system.
paragraphs.translation_en: The school is formulating a new safety system.
paragraphs.translation_id: Sekolah sedang merumuskan sistem keselamatan baru.

paragraphs.text: 他并不反对试点，只是提醒大家不要低估其中的制度利弊。
paragraphs.hanzi: 他并不反对试点，只是提醒大家不要低估其中的制度利弊。
paragraphs.pinyin: tā bìng bù fǎn duì shì diǎn ， zhǐ shì tí xǐng dà jiā bú yào dī gū qí zhōng de zhì dù lì bì 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄊㄚ ㄅㄧㄥˋ ㄅㄨˋ ㄈㄢˇ ㄉㄨㄟˋ ㄕˋ ㄉㄧㄢˇ ， ㄓˇ ㄕˋ ㄊㄧˊ ㄒㄧㄥˇ ㄉㄚˋ ㄐㄧㄚ ㄅㄨˊ ㄧㄠˋ ㄉㄧ ㄍㄨ ㄑㄧˊ ㄓㄨㄥ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄓˋ ㄉㄨˋ ㄌㄧˋ ㄅㄧˋ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Tā bìng bù fǎnduì shìdiǎn, zhǐshì tíxǐng dàjiā bú yào dīgū qízhōng de zhìdù lìbì.
paragraphs.translation: He is not against the pilot scheme; he is merely reminding everyone not to underestimate the institutional pros and cons involved.
paragraphs.translation_en: He is not against the pilot scheme; he is merely reminding everyone not to underestimate the institutional pros and cons involved.
paragraphs.translation_id: Dia tidak menentang program percontohan tersebut; dia hanya mengingatkan semua pihak agar tidak meremehkan pro dan kontra kelembagaan yang terkait.

paragraphs.text: 他曾在德国就读三年，因此对当地教育制度很熟悉。
paragraphs.hanzi: 他曾在德国就读三年，因此对当地教育制度很熟悉。
paragraphs.pinyin: tā céng zài dé guó jiù dú sān nián ， yīn cǐ duì dāng dì jiào yù zhì dù hěn shú xī 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄊㄚ ㄘㄥˊ ㄗㄞˋ ㄉㄜˊ ㄍㄨㄛˊ ㄐㄧㄡˋ ㄉㄨˊ ㄙㄢ ㄋㄧㄢˊ ， ㄧㄣ ㄘˇ ㄉㄨㄟˋ ㄉㄤ ㄉㄧˋ ㄐㄧㄠˋ ㄩˋ ㄓˋ ㄉㄨˋ ㄏㄣˇ ㄕㄨˊ ㄒㄧ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Tā céng zài Déguó jiùdú sān nián, yīncǐ duì dāngdì jiàoyù zhìdù hěn shúxī.
paragraphs.translation: He once studied in Germany for three years, so he is very familiar with the local education system.
paragraphs.translation_en: He once studied in Germany for three years, so he is very familiar with the local education system.
paragraphs.translation_id: Ia pernah belajar di Jerman selama tiga tahun, sehingga ia sangat paham dengan sistem pendidikan setempat.

paragraphs.text: 政府在沿海地区率先试行新的垃圾分类制度。
paragraphs.hanzi: 政府在沿海地区率先试行新的垃圾分类制度。
paragraphs.pinyin: zhèng fǔ zài yán hǎi dì qū shuài xiān shì xíng xīn de lā jī fēn lèi zhì dù 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄓㄥˋ ㄈㄨˇ ㄗㄞˋ ㄧㄢˊ ㄏㄞˇ ㄉㄧˋ ㄑㄩ ㄕㄨㄞˋ ㄒㄧㄢ ㄕˋ ㄒㄧㄥˊ ㄒㄧㄣ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄌㄚ ㄐㄧ ㄈㄣ ㄌㄟˋ ㄓˋ ㄉㄨˋ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Zhèngfǔ zài yánhǎi dìqū shuàixiān shìxíng xīn de lājī fēnlèi zhìdù.
paragraphs.translation: The government first piloted the new waste-sorting system in coastal areas.
paragraphs.translation_en: The government first piloted the new waste-sorting system in coastal areas.
paragraphs.translation_id: Pemerintah pertama kali menguji coba sistem pemilahan sampah yang baru di daerah pesisir.

title: 政府 — government; CL:個|个[ge4]
summary: A short passage about government; CL:個|个[ge4].
summary_en: A short passage about government; CL:個|个[ge4].

paragraphs.text: 市民对改善交通的需求十分急切，政府不能再拖延。
paragraphs.hanzi: 市民对改善交通的需求十分急切，政府不能再拖延。
paragraphs.pinyin: shì mín duì gǎi shàn jiāo tōng de xū qiú shí fēn jí qiè ， zhèng fǔ bù néng zài tuō yán 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄕˋ ㄇㄧㄣˊ ㄉㄨㄟˋ ㄍㄞˇ ㄕㄢˋ ㄐㄧㄠ ㄊㄨㄥ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄒㄩ ㄑㄧㄡˊ ㄕˊ ㄈㄣ ㄐㄧˊ ㄑㄧㄝˋ ， ㄓㄥˋ ㄈㄨˇ ㄅㄨˋ ㄋㄥˊ ㄗㄞˋ ㄊㄨㄛ ㄧㄢˊ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Shìmín duì gǎishàn jiāotōng de xūqiú shífēn jíqiè, zhèngfǔ bùnéng zài tuōyán.
paragraphs.translation: Citizens have a very urgent need for transport improvements, and the government cannot delay any longer.
paragraphs.translation_en: Citizens have a very urgent need for transport improvements, and the government cannot delay any longer.
paragraphs.translation_id: Masyarakat mempunyai kebutuhan yang sangat mendesak akan perbaikan transportasi, dan pemerintah tidak dapat menundanya lebih lama lagi.

paragraphs.text: 政府按照地形和人口密度重新划分了几个行政区域。
paragraphs.hanzi: 政府按照地形和人口密度重新划分了几个行政区域。
paragraphs.pinyin: zhèng fǔ àn zhào dì xíng hé rén kǒu mì dù chóng xīn huà fēn le jǐ gè xíng zhèng qū yù 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄓㄥˋ ㄈㄨˇ ㄢˋ ㄓㄠˋ ㄉㄧˋ ㄒㄧㄥˊ ㄏㄜˊ ㄖㄣˊ ㄎㄡˇ ㄇㄧˋ ㄉㄨˋ ㄔㄨㄥˊ ㄒㄧㄣ ㄏㄨㄚˋ ㄈㄣ ㄌㄜ˙ ㄐㄧˇ ㄍㄜˋ ㄒㄧㄥˊ ㄓㄥˋ ㄑㄩ ㄩˋ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Zhèngfǔ ànzhào dìxíng hé rénkǒu mìdù chóngxīn huàfēn le jǐ gè xíngzhèng qūyù.
paragraphs.translation: The government redivided several administrative regions according to terrain and population density.
paragraphs.translation_en: The government redivided several administrative regions according to terrain and population density.
paragraphs.translation_id: Pemerintah membagi kembali beberapa wilayah administratif menurut medan dan kepadatan penduduk.

paragraphs.text: 市政府号召市民减少一次性塑料制品的使用。
paragraphs.hanzi: 市政府号召市民减少一次性塑料制品的使用。
paragraphs.pinyin: shì zhèng fǔ hào zhào shì mín jiǎn shǎo yí cì xìng sù liào zhì pǐn de shǐ yòng 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄕˋ ㄓㄥˋ ㄈㄨˇ ㄏㄠˋ ㄓㄠˋ ㄕˋ ㄇㄧㄣˊ ㄐㄧㄢˇ ㄕㄠˇ ㄧˊ ㄘˋ ㄒㄧㄥˋ ㄙㄨˋ ㄌㄧㄠˋ ㄓˋ ㄆㄧㄣˇ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄕˇ ㄩㄥˋ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Shì zhèngfǔ hàozhào shìmín jiǎnshǎo yícìxìng sùliào zhìpǐn de shǐyòng.
paragraphs.translation: The city government called on residents to reduce the use of disposable plastic products.
paragraphs.translation_en: The city government called on residents to reduce the use of disposable plastic products.
paragraphs.translation_id: Pemerintah kota mengimbau warga untuk mengurangi penggunaan produk plastik sekali pakai.

paragraphs.text: 政府希望通过改革提高公共服务的效率。
paragraphs.hanzi: 政府希望通过改革提高公共服务的效率。
paragraphs.pinyin: zhèng fǔ xī wàng tōng guò gǎi gé tí gāo gōng gòng fú wù de xiào lǜ 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄓㄥˋ ㄈㄨˇ ㄒㄧ ㄨㄤˋ ㄊㄨㄥ ㄍㄨㄛˋ ㄍㄞˇ ㄍㄜˊ ㄊㄧˊ ㄍㄠ ㄍㄨㄥ ㄍㄨㄥˋ ㄈㄨˊ ㄨˋ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄒㄧㄠˋ ㄌㄩˋ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Zhèngfǔ xīwàng tōngguò gǎigé tígāo gōnggòng fúwù de xiàolǜ.
paragraphs.translation: The government hopes to improve the efficiency of public services through reform.
paragraphs.translation_en: The government hopes to improve the efficiency of public services through reform.
paragraphs.translation_id: Pemerintah berharap dapat meningkatkan efisiensi pelayanan publik melalui reformasi.

paragraphs.text: 政府开始清理河道垃圾，以改善水质。
paragraphs.hanzi: 政府开始清理河道垃圾，以改善水质。
paragraphs.pinyin: zhèng fǔ kāi shǐ qīng lǐ hé dào lā jī ， yǐ gǎi shàn shuǐ zhì 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄓㄥˋ ㄈㄨˇ ㄎㄞ ㄕˇ ㄑㄧㄥ ㄌㄧˇ ㄏㄜˊ ㄉㄠˋ ㄌㄚ ㄐㄧ ， ㄧˇ ㄍㄞˇ ㄕㄢˋ ㄕㄨㄟˇ ㄓˋ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Zhèngfǔ kāishǐ qīnglǐ hédào lājī, yǐ gǎishàn shuǐzhì.
paragraphs.translation: The government began clearing rubbish from the river channel to improve water quality.
paragraphs.translation_en: The government began clearing rubbish from the river channel to improve water quality.
paragraphs.translation_id: Pemerintah mulai membersihkan sampah dari saluran sungai untuk meningkatkan kualitas air.

paragraphs.text: 政府把更多资金投入到公共交通。
paragraphs.hanzi: 政府把更多资金投入到公共交通。
paragraphs.pinyin: zhèng fǔ bǎ gèng duō zī jīn tóu rù dào gōng gòng jiāo tōng 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄓㄥˋ ㄈㄨˇ ㄅㄚˇ ㄍㄥˋ ㄉㄨㄛ ㄗ ㄐㄧㄣ ㄊㄡˊ ㄖㄨˋ ㄉㄠˋ ㄍㄨㄥ ㄍㄨㄥˋ ㄐㄧㄠ ㄊㄨㄥ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Zhèngfǔ bǎ gèng duō zījīn tóurù dào gōnggòng jiāotōng.
paragraphs.translation: The government is investing more funds into public transport.
paragraphs.translation_en: The government is investing more funds into public transport.
paragraphs.translation_id: Pemerintah menginvestasikan lebih banyak dana untuk transportasi umum.

title: 反而 — on the contrary, instead
title_en: 反而 — on the contrary, instead
summary: A short passage about on the contrary, instead.
summary_en: A short passage about on the contrary, instead.
summary_id: Bacaan singkat tentang justru sebaliknya, malah.

paragraphs.text: 西餐桌上如果没有叉子，我反而不知道该怎么吃。
paragraphs.hanzi: 西餐桌上如果没有叉子，我反而不知道该怎么吃。
paragraphs.pinyin: xī cān zhuō shàng rú guǒ méi yǒu chā zi ， wǒ fǎn ér bù zhī dào gāi zěn me chī 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄒㄧ ㄘㄢ ㄓㄨㄛ ㄕㄤˋ ㄖㄨˊ ㄍㄨㄛˇ ㄇㄟˊ ㄧㄡˇ ㄔㄚ ㄗ˙ ， ㄨㄛˇ ㄈㄢˇ ㄦˊ ㄅㄨˋ ㄓ ㄉㄠˋ ㄍㄞ ㄗㄣˇ ㄇㄜ˙ ㄔ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Xīcān zhuō shang rúguǒ méiyǒu chāzi, wǒ fǎn’ér bù zhīdào gāi zěnme chī.
paragraphs.translation: At a Western dining table, if there is no fork, I actually do not know how to eat.
paragraphs.translation_en: At a Western dining table, if there is no fork, I actually do not know how to eat.
paragraphs.translation_id: Di meja makan bergaya Barat, kalau tidak ada garpu, jujur saja, saya tidak tahu cara makan.

paragraphs.text: 如果不懂得配合，两个人一起划反而会更累。
paragraphs.hanzi: 如果不懂得配合，两个人一起划反而会更累。
paragraphs.pinyin: rú guǒ bù dǒng de pèi hé ， liǎng gè rén yì qǐ huà fǎn ér huì gèng lèi 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄖㄨˊ ㄍㄨㄛˇ ㄅㄨˋ ㄉㄨㄥˇ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄆㄟˋ ㄏㄜˊ ， ㄌㄧㄤˇ ㄍㄜˋ ㄖㄣˊ ㄧˋ ㄑㄧˇ ㄏㄨㄚˋ ㄈㄢˇ ㄦˊ ㄏㄨㄟˋ ㄍㄥˋ ㄌㄟˋ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Rúguǒ bù dǒngde pèihé, liǎng gè rén yìqǐ huá fǎn'ér huì gèng lèi.
paragraphs.translation: If they do not know how to cooperate, two people paddling together will actually be more tiring.
paragraphs.translation_en: If they do not know how to cooperate, two people paddling together will actually be more tiring.
paragraphs.translation_id: Jika tidak tahu cara bekerja sama, dua orang yang mengayuh bersama justru akan lebih melelahkan.

paragraphs.text: 作客海外多年以后，他反而更清楚自己文化身份中的复杂性。
paragraphs.hanzi: 作客海外多年以后，他反而更清楚自己文化身份中的复杂性。
paragraphs.pinyin: zuò kè hǎi wài duō nián yǐ hòu ， tā fǎn ér gèng qīng chǔ zì jǐ wén huà shēn fèn zhōng de fù zá xìng 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄗㄨㄛˋ ㄎㄜˋ ㄏㄞˇ ㄨㄞˋ ㄉㄨㄛ ㄋㄧㄢˊ ㄧˇ ㄏㄡˋ ， ㄊㄚ ㄈㄢˇ ㄦˊ ㄍㄥˋ ㄑㄧㄥ ㄔㄨˇ ㄗˋ ㄐㄧˇ ㄨㄣˊ ㄏㄨㄚˋ ㄕㄣ ㄈㄣˋ ㄓㄨㄥ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄈㄨˋ ㄗㄚˊ ㄒㄧㄥˋ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Zuòkè hǎiwài duōnián yǐhòu, tā fǎn'ér gèng qīngchǔ zìjǐ wénhuà shēnfèn zhōng de fùzáxìng.
paragraphs.translation: After spending many years overseas as a guest, he became even clearer about the complexity of his own cultural identity.
paragraphs.translation_en: After spending many years overseas as a guest, he became even clearer about the complexity of his own cultural identity.
paragraphs.translation_id: Setelah menghabiskan waktu bertahun-tahun sebagai tamu di luar negeri, ia semakin memahami kompleksitas identitas budayanya sendiri.

paragraphs.text: 在这座高成本城市，单身青年的住房压力反而更加突出。
paragraphs.hanzi: 在这座高成本城市，单身青年的住房压力反而更加突出。
paragraphs.pinyin: zài zhè zuò gāo chéng běn chéng shì ， dān shēn qīng nián de zhù fáng yā lì fǎn ér gèng jiā tū chū 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄗㄞˋ ㄓㄜˋ ㄗㄨㄛˋ ㄍㄠ ㄔㄥˊ ㄅㄣˇ ㄔㄥˊ ㄕˋ ， ㄉㄢ ㄕㄣ ㄑㄧㄥ ㄋㄧㄢˊ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄓㄨˋ ㄈㄤˊ ㄧㄚ ㄌㄧˋ ㄈㄢˇ ㄦˊ ㄍㄥˋ ㄐㄧㄚ ㄊㄨ ㄔㄨ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Zài zhè zuò gāo chéngběn chéngshì, dānshēn qīngnián de zhùfáng yālì fǎn'ér gèngjiā tūchū.
paragraphs.translation: In this high-cost city, housing pressure on single young people is even more pronounced.
paragraphs.translation_en: In this high-cost city, housing pressure on single young people is even more pronounced.
paragraphs.translation_id: Di kota berbiaya tinggi ini, tekanan terhadap perumahan bagi kaum muda lajang bahkan lebih besar lagi.

paragraphs.text: 他明明很感激对方，却说得别扭，反而像是在抱怨。
paragraphs.hanzi: 他明明很感激对方，却说得别扭，反而像是在抱怨。
paragraphs.pinyin: tā míng míng hěn gǎn jī duì fāng ， què shuō dé biè niǔ ， fǎn ér xiàng shì zài bào yuàn 。
